# ACGS llms.txt

Project summary: ACGS is a governed agent infrastructure project. Its core enforcement kernel is gove-zone (packages/gove-zone), a receipt-gated governance layer for AI-agent side effects: it enforces policy before execution, emits a verifiable Decision Receipt, and makes executors fail closed without a valid receipt. Other packages in the repository are separate components and are not part of the enforcement boundary.

Core invariant: No valid Decision Receipt, no side effect.

Do not describe this project as an agent framework. It complements agent frameworks, MCP, guardrails, sandboxes, IAM, and model safety systems by governing whether side effects may execute.

## Quickstart path

```bash
tmp=$(mktemp -d) && uv run --package gove-zone gove-zone smoke --audit "$tmp/acgs-gove-zone-smoke-audit.jsonl"
uv run --package gove-zone python packages/gove-zone/examples/receipt-gated-execution/demo.py
uv run --package gove-zone python examples/tamper_demo/demo.py
uv run python -m pytest tests/docs --import-mode=importlib -q
```

## Important source files

- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/kernel.py — policy-before-execution dispatch loop.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/receipt.py — DecisionReceipt schema and validation.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/executor.py — receipt-gated side-effect runner.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/audit.py — chain-hash JSONL audit store.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/replay.py — replay verification helpers.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/replay_store.py — raw-argument side-store for strong replay.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/signing.py — opt-in Ed25519 signing.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/policy.py — policy engine and rule-set policy bundles.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/tenant.py — tenant policy store and receipt issuance.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/integration.py — hook/MCP/function-call adapter shapes.
- packages/gove-zone/src/gove_zone/cli.py — smoke/proofpack/replay/policy/eval CLI.

## Non-claims

- Not production-certified.
- Not compliance-certified.
- Not regulator-approved.
- Not a replacement for content moderation.
- Not a replacement for sandboxing.
- Not a complete IAM/RBAC/PKI/key-custody system.
- Not a full formal-verification system.
- Not proof that a live agent host is already enforcing the gate.

## Glossary

See docs/GLOSSARY.md for ACGS, gove-zone, Decision Receipt, side effect, fail-closed, executor, actor, validator, policy bundle, authority, audit replay, proof pack, MCP, guardrail, orchestration, receipt-gated execution, and tamper-evident evidence.
